title: Asheron's Call Server Information
description: A document served at the root of an Asheron's Call server's public game endpoint. All fields are optional; unknown fields are ignored by consumers.

schema.description: Canonical URL of the JSON Schema describing this document.

version.description: Version of the server information document format. This schema describes version 1.

name.description: The server or world name as configured by the operator.

updated_at.description: When this document was generated, as an RFC3339 timestamp with an explicit offset. Used as the measurement time when population.updated_at is absent.

population.description: Current in-world player population. All nested fields are optional.

count.description: Number of connected, in-world player characters, including bots and multiboxed characters. When absent, no population count is recorded.

updated_at.description: When the population was measured, as an RFC3339 timestamp with an explicit offset. Falls back to the document's updated_at when absent.

emulator.description: Server emulator software and versions. All nested fields are optional.

dat_iterations.description: Iteration counts keyed by DAT filename. Values are nonnegative integers.
